question: Why would the man of God not eat with the king?

readings.answer: Because the word of the Lord had commanded him not to eat or drink there.
readings.support: For I was commanded by the word of the Lord: | You must not eat bread or drink water

assessments.reason: Verse 9 states, “For I was commanded by the word of the Lord: ‘You must not eat bread or drink water,’” directly explaining why he would not eat with the king.

reason: The passage explicitly says the Lord commanded him not to eat or drink there, matching the key.
